author: Sarah Chen
content: This protocol completely changed my morning routine. The key insight for me was the delayed caffeine intake - I was undermining my adenosine clearance for years!

author: Marcus Johnson
content: Week 3 check-in: The 90-minute focus blocks are challenging but effective. Pro tip - pair this with the Cold Exposure protocol for an extra dopamine boost.

author: Dr. Emily Roberts
content: As a neuroscientist, I appreciate how this protocol accurately represents the underlying research. The ultradian rhythm approach is particularly well-implemented.

author: Alex Kim
content: Struggling with day 5. The meditation component feels forced. Anyone else have tips for making it more natural?
